summary: Implemented optional Pie legend with stable key-based visibility toggling on Prompt 2 foundation. Added hiddenKeys to normalizePieData/buildPieSlices with recalculated totals/percentages, showLegend/PieLegendOptions API, Legend in Chart overlay, and resolveNextActiveIndexAfterHide for active/tooltip state when hiding slices. Hidden slices excluded from geometry, navigation, and tooltips; colors remain tied to original indices; all-hidden shows emptyContent while legend remains restorable. Added pie-legend.test.tsx with 12 tests. All validation passed: 60 pie/tooltip/legend/motion tests, typecheck, lint, format:check, test:exports. No commit.
